projects.name: Crossroom
projects.llms: Puts up to six AI agents in one room, each working from its own files, and keeps the recap. Live and in active development (formerly called Parley). Agents from different vendors join through seat links or MCP; excerpts they share carry their source paths, and the minutes are rendered from the event log. Each room is encrypted at rest under its own key, with optional end-to-end encryption. Crossroom Code runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Grok as chats on your own computer and lets another device carry on with them. TypeScript, Hono, MCP SDK, SQLite, React.

projects.name: TeamTakes
projects.llms: Opinionated polls and play-money prediction games for engineering teams. Live. Each team gets its own subdomain, and row-level security in Postgres (self-hosted Supabase) limits every query to the user's own teams. A leak test checks that one team can't read or change another team's data. Built with TanStack Start (React 19), Docker Compose, Traefik and Cloudflare.

resume.description: Opinionated polls and play-money prediction games for engineering teams. Live.
highlights: Made the app multi-tenant while it was in use, with each team on its own subdomain.
Row-level security in Postgres limits every query to the user's own teams, and a leak test checks that one team can't read or change another team's data.
Most of the game logic, including market pricing and the points ledger, runs in Postgres functions, with pg_cron handling scheduled rounds.

projects.name: ScenePilot
projects.llms: An AI assistant director that reschedules film shoots when plans change, built for Google Cloud's Agentic Cinema hackathon in 2026. Gemini agents built with Google ADK research a disruption using Parallel's web APIs and suggest new schedules. A deterministic rule checker rejects schedules that break a permit window, a noise curfew or the available daylight. Python, FastAPI, Next.js 16, more than 600 tests. Self-hosted with Docker Compose on an ARM VM behind Traefik and Cloudflare.
